issues.problem: The host-agnostic core validator fails on the package head. sb-doctor.sh gained `sb_runtime_codex_home() { printf '%s' "${CODEX_HOME:-${HOME}/.codex}"; }` and an `env -u KAY_HOME -u CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR -u CODEX_HOME -u CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR ...` line, both hits for the [scripts]-tier CODEX_HOME / CURSOR_ patterns. Consequences: (1) tests/scripts/test-validate-host-agnostic-core.sh 'live repo passes validate-host-agnostic-core' fails, so CI (full suite) goes red; (2) every user's /sb:doctor prints 'FAIL: D17 — host-specific bleed in SB core' and OVERALL: FAIL, since D17 validates the plugin's own REPO_ROOT; (3) run-pre-release-host-smoke.sh's mandatory structural stage and host-smoke-cell structural-only fail, so release step 4 cannot pass. The author's report claims every touched test is green and 17/17 for this file; that was true at 83d7bf3 only.
issues.evidence: cd <worktree> && bash scripts/validate-host-agnostic-core.sh -> '[scripts] scripts/sb-doctor.sh:117: CODEX_HOME ... [scripts] scripts/sb-doctor.sh:236: CODEX_HOME ... [scripts] scripts/sb-doctor.sh:236: CURSOR_ ... validate-host-agnostic-core: FAIL (3 violations)'. bash tests/run-all-tests.sh tests/scripts/test-validate-host-agnostic-core.sh -> '16 passed, 1 failed ... FAIL: live repo passes validate-host-agnostic-core'. Restoring sb-doctor.sh from 308baa6 in a clone -> 'OK — core is host-agent agnostic'. Real sb-doctor probe output: 'FAIL: D17 — host-specific bleed in SB core — run: bash scripts/validate-host-agnostic-core.sh'. git blame: both lines from ae93606.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the host-specific variable names out of sb-doctor.sh: reuse a shared scrub helper from a library the validator already treats as host tooling (e.g. move the unset list into scripts/lib/pre-release-host-isolation.sh's sb_smoke_clear_host_env or a new scripts/lib helper, and call it inside the smoke subshell), and drop the local sb_runtime_codex_home fallback (use runtime-paths.sh's helper, which already honours CODEX_HOME/KAY_HOME) — or, if the names must stay, add a narrow, commented allowlist entry for sb-doctor.sh in validate-host-agnostic-core.sh. Re-run test-validate-host-agnostic-core.sh and a real sb-doctor D17.

issues.problem: A command stub for a composer that is removed (skill deleted or dropped from COMPOSERS) is kept forever: the generator only WARNs 'missing', keeps any stub that has frontmatter, and the mirror validator passes. issues.problem: Only regular files are compared, so a committed symlink inside agents/claude, host-bundles/* or the hidden source trees (which ship in the plugin payload) is never reported as drift.
issues.evidence: Clone: ln -s /etc/hostname 'agents/claude/sb:init/evil'; bash scripts/validate-plugin-mirror.sh -> 'Plugin mirror OK' (rc=0).
